budgetWords.title: Budget words
budgetWords.description: For {products_under}: words written after a number that multiply it, one per line as word = number (for example k = 1000, thousand = 1000, million = 1000000), in each language your visitors write in. The budget is the number after one of the answer's keywords, or one written with these words; a number right after a word, such as iPhone 15, is part of a name.
